core.big_idea: Covenant life involved love, remembrance, obedience, and real consequences.

passages.reading_note: Read in context; use age-appropriate portions without changing the claim.

core.metanarrative_position: Deuteronomy frames covenant life around love, remembrance, teaching, obedience, and consequential choices

claims.statement: Deuteronomy calls Israel to love the LORD wholeheartedly and keep His words before the next generation.
Deuteronomy 30 presents life and death, blessing and curse, as serious covenant alternatives.
These warnings belong first to Israel under the Mosaic covenant and should not become simplistic material-prosperity promises for Christians.
claims.interpretive_hinge: This conclusion depends on the approved curriculum framework and its distinction between direct text, synthesis, inference, and age-appropriate application; Scripture does not directly mandate this exact curriculum formulation.
claims.prohibited_overstatement: Do not present this framework conclusion as an explicit biblical command or quotation.

learning.extension_objective: Identify the immediate context and genre, then distinguish what the text directly states from a reasonable inference and application.
